$comment: Single source of truth for component identity, sprite geometry, and pin kinds. Adding an I2C sensor = an entry here, no firmware or JS change for identity (whoamiReg/whoamiVal: hex strings matching the WHOAMI <addr> <reg> reply) and, with optional readRegs, for data. readRegs = [{reg: hex string, len: 1..16 bytes, signed: bool, scale: multiplier, fields: reading names}]; len is split evenly across fields, each big-endian. Polling only reads: a chip that must be configured before it converts cannot stream this way. kind drives wire color and the wiring-correctness check.

i2c.label: MPU6050
i2c.$readRegs: 1/4096 per LSB = the +-8g range the node firmware configures. Not polled on that firmware: its stream already owns these fields (adapter.streamKeys).

always.label: Breadboard
always.$comment: ponytail: two rail pins only. A real pin-grid (rows x columns) is a v2 — nothing in this kit can detect which breadboard hole a jumper is in, so finer granularity would be modelled fiction.
